document.abstract: This article discusses the how and why of static electricity, and some oj the problems it causes for the film and television industries. The roles oj static eliminators, ionized air blowers, and anti-static solutions are discussed, among other solutions. The aim of the article is to increase understanding of the basic nature of static, with particular reference to its effect on dust contamination, and to provide simple solutions leading to improved quality, reduced waste, improvements in operator satisfaction, and generally increased profitability.
